subject.title: [Feature]: Expose AI model used and usage cost when using openrouter/auto

question: Should OpenClaw add an additive selected-versus-resolved model and provider-reported cost contract for `openrouter/auto`, and which agent/session/footer surfaces must expose it?
rationale: The missing behavior crosses provider transport, persisted session metadata, agent runtime state, usage templates, and user-facing footer wording, so automation should not choose the public API shape alone.

options.title: Add a shared metadata contract
options.body: Capture resolved backend model and provider-cost metadata once and expose it consistently through agent, session/status, transcript, usage-template, and footer surfaces.

options.title: Limit to response footer
options.body: Only display the routed OpenRouter model and exact cost in response footers, accepting that runtime and status metadata remain incomplete.

options.title: Fold into broader observability
options.body: Make the broader resolved-backend-model work own the contract, but keep this issue open until it explicitly covers OpenRouter auto footer and cost semantics.

recommendation.title: Add a shared metadata contract
recommendation.body: Capture resolved backend model and provider-cost metadata once and expose it consistently through agent, session/status, transcript, usage-template, and footer surfaces.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest current history and review signal across OpenRouter cost reconciliation and the provider/runtime contract surfaces.
